projects.subtitle: EISC Metaverse
projects.content: It is a metaverse developed for the School of Systems and Computing Engineering at Universidad del Valle, allowing real-time interaction in a Web 3D environment among students, professors, and the general community

projects.subtitle: DomoGallery
projects.content: It is a first-person Web 3D virtual space, where a dome presents an aerial view of the Universidad del Valle (CO) campus and an art gallery displays self-created poetry works

projects.subtitle: Portfolio Fabian Valencia
projects.content: This portfolio was developed in Web 3D to showcase my professional profile, projects, skills, and research outcomes

projects.subtitle: Art Gallery
projects.content: This art gallery is a Web 3D virtual space, resulting from research on how to develop in Three.js and Cannon.js, integrate an avatar, and model with Blender using UV Wrapping and Baking

projects.subtitle: ARProducts
projects.content: Application to showcase products in augmented reality, developed in Unity using Google's ARCore

projects.subtitle: ARMachine
projects.content: Application of an electric machine to help Electronic Engineering students learn how the electromagnetic field works. This project was developed in Unity using Google's ARCore

projects.subtitle: Fireboy & Watergirl
projects.content: This game is based on the popular game Fireboy and Watergirl, which was developed in WebGL
